Game Overview

At its heart, Stone Pile is a arcade game about stack stones by color in the fast-paced world of Stone Pile, where quick decisions and precise timing are your keys to success. Race against time to build the tallest stack without letting it topple for a high score amidst charming pixel-art scenery.

How to Play

Each session of Stone Pile follows a consistent rhythm. Stack stones by color in the fast-paced world of Stone Pile, where quick decisions and precise timing are your keys to success. Race against time to build the tallest stack without letting it topple for a high score amidst charming pixel-art scenery.
